## Conclusions
- With 1,500 queries (5 disjoint folds of 300, each with its own caption pool of about 690) the CI is about ±2 points,
  and every MobileCLIP2 variant beats the baseline significantly. Ranking: B ≈ S2 (+8) > S0 (+6) > S0@224 (+5.5) >
  S0@192 (+3.4) > CLIP-norm (+1.5) > CLIP. None of this was visible on the sample (001).
- Lowering S0's internal resolution costs 0.5 points at 224 and 2.6 at 192. Whether that buys S22 latency is the
  open question for the device experiments.
- The leaderboard ranks by accuracy among valid models (<35 ms). B shares the baseline's ViT-B/16 image tower
  (baseline about 22 ms on S22), so B and S2 may fit the budget with about 2 points more than S0. **Decision:**
  profile CLIP, CLIP-norm, S0 (256/224/192), S2 and B on the S22 before choosing a base model.
- Caveat: the validation set is a proxy. Its captions are 7.2 vs 5.0 words and 2.3 vs 4.1 per image, so absolute
  values aren't comparable with the sample. Use it to rank and select only.
